publish-appstore-connect.description: Archive, export, upload and attach the processed build to an App Store Connect version

steps.name: set_build_number
steps.run: asc xcode version edit --project RssReader.xcodeproj --target RssReader --version "$VERSION" --next-build-number --app "$APP_ID" --platform IOS --output json

steps.name: archive
steps.run: asc xcode archive --project RssReader.xcodeproj --scheme RssReader --configuration Release --archive-path "$ARCHIVE_PATH" --xcodebuild-flag=-destination --xcodebuild-flag=generic/platform=iOS --xcodebuild-flag=-allowProvisioningUpdates --xcodebuild-flag=DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$TEAM_ID" --xcodebuild-flag=CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Automatic --xcodebuild-flag=CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="Apple Development" --output json
